method.baseline: Directly imported current select_pool_mixture; quotas 160/320/320/0/0; seed 20260930; family_id + canonical episode_id sort then random.Random(seed+bucket_index).shuffle; existing G1/G2 canonical episode IDs presumed after materialization.
method.fair: Deterministic length cycle <=1K,1-2K,2-4K,1-2K,2-4K; source cycle official,gen,gen,official,gen inside each bucket. Choose least-seen global task, then least-seen source-task; SHA256(seed:bucket:source:task) ties. Choose least-seen base within chosen task, then SHA256(seed:sample_id) ties. Without replacement. Same_800 obeys exactly160/320/320 and320 official/480gen.
method.protected_variant: Before least-seen task ordering, prioritize yet-unseen members of the55 nonARC1/noV2 training tasks when their source/length slot occurs. On old3000 index36 are eligible<=4K; after removing53 one-demo LOO,35 remain eligible. Current2947 pool leaves20 inaccessible at4K; this does not prove complete official all-query/all-LOO pools cannot shorten them.
method.fairness_limit: Coverage-oriented heuristic, not optimal allocation and not evidence of learning improvement. Source40/60 provisional; full task coverage not possible with800rows under current source/length restrictions.
method.budget_comparisons: Same800 rows and same full-token cap are separate experiments. Token-cap prefix stops before the first overflow row, never skips it to choose shorter rows; supervised-token cap is an additional optimization-volume comparison and is not compute matched. Nondivisible prefix ratios can differ from20/40/40 and40/60.
method.time_proxy: sum(full_tokens) for linear work and sum(full_tokens^2) for dense attention component only; neither is seconds, a validated Qwen/GDN cost model, peak memory, or L4 feasibility. No wallclock extrapolation.
method.seed_sensitivity: 20 predeclared consecutive seeds20260930..20260949 on same legal2947 pool. Not seed optimization.
method.pool_scope_warning: 2947 is only a filter of the existing3000 metadata index. It is not all official test/LOO, not all2990 generated bases, not newly materialized train episodes. Existing raw2240 bases excluded from all800/token budget comparisons.
